"Create a completely NEW mobile-only fantasy MMORPG called AETHERIA from scratch.

GRAPHICS: Use beautiful HD 2.5D isometric pixel art graphics. Fixed camera angled diagonally from above, following the player. Detailed environments, smaller characters, smooth animations and rich fantasy colors. Optimize for Android smartphones.

CHARACTER CREATION: Players choose male or female, enter their own unique character name, select Angels or Demons and choose one of three classes:

- Warrior: strong melee fighter.
- Mage: powerful magic and ranged attacks.
- Assassin: fast attacks and critical damage.

Include hairstyles, hair colors, eye colors, three starting outfits and a character preview. Angels have celestial wings, Demons have demonic wings.

WORLD: Eight regions: Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion and Tower of Eternity. Include Dawnshire, Stonewatch, Sunmarket and Frosthaven.

GAMEPLAY: Real-time combat, normal attacks, class skills, auto-attack, HP/MP, potions, experience, leveling, respawning monsters, quests, dungeons and bosses. Each class has unique weapons, armor and a main skill upgradeable to level 10.

EQUIPMENT AND LOOT: 9 equipment slots. Direct drop chances: Common 60%, Grey 25%, Green 10%, Blue 5%. All direct drops are T3. Purple and higher never drop directly.

CRAFTING AND FUSION: Combine 4 identical items: T3 to T2, T2 to T1, T1 to next rarity T3. No random item destruction. Craft Legendary using rare materials, recipes and boss drops. Four Legendary create Mythic; four Mythic create Divine. Mythic and Divine never drop directly. Boss stones have up to 3 bonuses. Critical chance capped at 50%.

ECONOMY: Gathering, crafting, materials, recipes, blacksmiths, merchants, storage, Gold, Gems and player marketplace. Configurable prices for crafting, fusion, potions and teleportation. No repair system.

QUESTS AND NPCS: Main and side quests, rewards and interactive NPCs. Starting village has blacksmith, merchant, quest NPC, storage NPC and teleporter.

SHOP: Costumes, hairstyles, mounts, pets, weapon effects, faction wings, Gems and optional premium membership. Wings are quest or shop rewards only, never dropped, traded or fused. Gems are also earnable through gameplay. Free-to-play without mandatory purchases.

MOBILE UI: Virtual joystick, attack and skill buttons, interaction, mount, auto-attack, HP/MP bars, minimap, inventory, equipment, quests, shop and character profile. All text in English.

DEVELOPMENT IN TWO PHASES:
Phase 1: Character creation, factions, classes, starting village, first region, movement, combat, monsters, inventory, equipment and basic quests.
Phase 2: Remaining regions, crafting, fusion, marketplace, economy, dungeons, bosses, shop, mounts, pets, wings and world events.

Prepare for future real multiplayer, accounts and persistent data. Never pretend local simulation is real multiplayer.

Build a playable mobile game, not a mockup. Use modular code, optimize for smartphones, test features and fix errors. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

Given the enormous scope, I'll build:
- Phase 1 fully: character creation (gender, name, faction Angels/Demons, 3 classes, hair styles/colors, eye colors, outfits, preview, wings), starting village Dawnshire, first region Greendale, joystick movement, real-time combat, auto-attack, skills, HP/MP, potions, XP/leveling, respawning monsters, quests, inventory, 9 equipment slots, drops.

Canvas rendering with isometric tiles drawn procedurally (pixel-art style via imageSmoothing off, drawing to offscreen tile canvases at creation).

Given constraints of time/tokens, I'll write a fairly comprehensive game but keep code efficient. Let's target maybe ~5000-7000 lines total across modules. Need to be realistic — I should generate a solid playable game covering all major systems in a condensed but functional way.

index.html — canvas + UI overlays (HUD, buttons, modals for inventory/equipment/quests/shop/craft/profile/map/creation).
js/data.js — game data: classes, factions, regions, towns, monsters, items, recipes, shop, quests.

World design: Isometric tile map. Tile size 64x32 iso. Each region is a procedurally-generated map with deterministic seed: terrain types (grass, forest, ore rocks, water, desert, snow, ash, etc.), decorations, structures for towns, NPC positions, spawn zones.

Collision: simple tile walkability.

Rendering: draw tiles sorted by screen y; characters drawn as procedural pixel sprites (small, ~24x36 px scaled). Generate sprites once into offscreen canvases per (class, gender, hair, outfit, direction, faction wings). Keep animation: walk bobbing, attack swing, wing flap.

Monsters: per region lists with stats scaling; slimes, wolves, bandits, spiders, wraiths, yetis, scorpions, demons, etc. Bosses per region + dungeons.

Items: tiers T3 (base) → fuse 4→T2 → T1 (epic? no—) Let me parse rules: rarities: Common (white), Grey? Actually "Common 60%, Grey 25%, Green 10%, Blue 5%". Grey seems odd but follow: Common (white), Grey, Green (uncommon), Blue (rare), then Purple (epic), Orange? Legendary, Mythic, Divine. Direct drops only Common/Grey/Green/Blue and always T3. Fusion: 4 identical items: T3→T2, T2→T1, and T1 + next rarity T3? "T1 to next rarity T3" means fusing four T1 of a rarity upgrades to T3 of next rarity tier? Hmm: "Combine 4 identical items: T3 to T2, T2 to T1, T1 to next rarity T3." So tier chain within quality: T3→T2→T1, then when you fuse 4 identical T1 items of rarity X you get T3 item of next rarity level. Then eventually reach Legendary via crafting with rare materials/recipes/boss drops. Then 4 Legendary → Mythic (presumably same slot type T-something), 4 Mythic → Divine. Mythic/Divine never drop.

I'll implement: qualities: common, grey, green, blue, purple, legendary, mythic, divine. Drop pool: common 60, grey 25, green 10, blue 5 (T3 only). Purple obtainable via fusion chain: fuse 4 blue T1 → purple T3. Then purple T3→T2→T1, 4 purple T1 → legendary? But spec says craft Legendary using rare materials/recipes/boss drops, and 4 Legendary → Mythic. I'll do both: purple T1 x4 → Legendary base, crafted Legendary via blacksmith with materials. Legendary T3→T2→T1 fuse, 4 Legendary T1 → Mythic T3, mythic fuse chain, 4 Mythic T1 → Divine T3. Critical chance capped 50%. Boss stone drops (accessory "stones") with up to 3 bonus stats.

Equipment slots (9): head, chest, legs, boots, gloves, weapon, offhand, amulet, ring. Wings separate (statless cosmetic, quest/shop only).

Economy: gathering nodes (herbs, ore, wood), Gold, Gems (earnable), marketplace (local simulated board with NPC listings + player sell listings stored locally — must not pretend real multiplayer; label "Marketplace (offline preview — real cross-player trading comes with online accounts)"). Prices configurable in a config object.

Quests: main chain + side quests per region. Keep ~20 quests first pass auto-driven.

Dungeons: portal NPC in towns leading to instanced mini-maps with boss at end. Implement as separate region-maps with entrance/exit.

Mounts/pets: shop purchase + quest rewards; mount increases speed (visual: riding), pet follows and picks up loot/auto-attacks lightly.

Character creation: full screen flow: gender → name → faction → class → appearance → preview (rotating? animated) → start.

Save/load: localStorage with versioning; "accounts" prep: a profile object keyed by account stub.

UI mobile: joystick left bottom, attack + 2 skill buttons + auto toggle + potion + interact right side, top bar HP/MP/XP + minimap + gold/gems, menu buttons: Bag, Equip, Quests, Shop, Craft, Map, Profile.

Performance: cap DPR at 1.5, limit entity draw distance, offscreen sprite caching, tile chunk caching maybe. Keep region maps modest (e.g., 96x96 tiles).

"Create a completely NEW mobile-only fantasy MMORPG called AETHERIA from scratch.

GRAPHICS: Use beautiful HD 2.5D isometric pixel art graphics. Fixed camera angled diagonally from above, following the player. Detailed environments, smaller characters, smooth animations and rich fantasy colors. Optimize for Android smartphones.

CHARACTER CREATION: Players choose male or female, enter their own unique character name, select Angels or Demons and choose one of three classes:

- Warrior: strong melee fighter.
- Mage: powerful magic and ranged attacks.
- Assassin: fast attacks and critical damage.

Include hairstyles, hair colors, eye colors, three starting outfits and a character preview. Angels have celestial wings, Demons have demonic wings.

WORLD: Eight regions: Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion and Tower of Eternity. Include Dawnshire, Stonewatch, Sunmarket and Frosthaven.

GAMEPLAY: Real-time combat, normal attacks, class skills, auto-attack, HP/MP, potions, experience, leveling, respawning monsters, quests, dungeons and bosses. Each class has unique weapons, armor and a main skill upgradeable to level 10.

EQUIPMENT AND LOOT: 9 equipment slots. Direct drop chances: Common 60%, Grey 25%, Green 10%, Blue 5%. All direct drops are T3. Purple and higher never drop directly.

CRAFTING AND FUSION: Combine 4 identical items: T3 to T2, T2 to T1, T1 to next rarity T3. No random item destruction. Craft Legendary using rare materials, recipes and boss drops. Four Legendary create Mythic; four Mythic create Divine. Mythic and Divine never drop directly. Boss stones have up to 3 bonuses. Critical chance capped at 50%.

ECONOMY: Gathering, crafting, materials, recipes, blacksmiths, merchants, storage, Gold, Gems and player marketplace. Configurable prices for crafting, fusion, potions and teleportation. No repair system.

QUESTS AND NPCS: Main and side quests, rewards and interactive NPCs. Starting village has blacksmith, merchant, quest NPC, storage NPC and teleporter.

SHOP: Costumes, hairstyles, mounts, pets, weapon effects, faction wings, Gems and optional premium membership. Wings are quest or shop rewards only, never dropped, traded or fused. Gems are also earnable through gameplay. Free-to-play without mandatory purchases.

MOBILE UI: Virtual joystick, attack and skill buttons, interaction, mount, auto-attack, HP/MP bars, minimap, inventory, equipment, quests, shop and character profile. All text in English.

DEVELOPMENT IN TWO PHASES:
Phase 1: Character creation, factions, classes, starting village, first region, movement, combat, monsters, inventory, equipment and basic quests.
Phase 2: Remaining regions, crafting, fusion, marketplace, economy, dungeons, bosses, shop, mounts, pets, wings and world events.

Prepare for future real multiplayer, accounts and persistent data. Never pretend local simulation is real multiplayer.

Build a playable mobile game, not a mockup. Use modular code, optimize for smartphones, test features and fix errors. (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)
